values:
禁锢最靠后的2名敌人，随后将其传送至目标地点落下，并对该地图格范围内的敌人造成200% + 50% ATK伤害并使其倒地，自动战斗时目标地点优先选择最靠前的敌人所在位置。
被动地，皮帕释放技能时有20%概率造成”失控”，该技能“失控”时，目标会被传送至敌方半场随机位置，包括奇怪的位置！技能施放期间皮帕处于霸体状态。

Pippa immobilizes 2 rearmost enemies, then teleports them onto a target tile and drops them, dealing 200% + 50% ATK damage to the enemy on that tile and knocking them down. When auto-cast is on, Pippa prioritizes targeting the tile of the frontmost enemy.
Passive. Whenever Pippa casts a skill, the skill has a 20% chance to go out of control. When this happens, the skill target is teleported to a random location on the enemy side of the battlefield, sometimes ending up in very unexpected places!
Pippa remains unaffected while casting the skill.
造成的伤害提升至250% + 50% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 250% + 50% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至300% + 50% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 300% + 50% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至350% + 50% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 350% + 50% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至400% + 50% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 400% + 50% ATK.
Pippa fires magic missiles in quick succession.
向敌人连续发射9枚魔法飞弹，每枚弹道造成60% + 6% ATK伤害。该技能“失控”时，魔法飞弹将攻击战场上的随机目标，包括自己人！

Pippa fires 9 magic missiles at enemies in quick succession, each missile dealing 60% + 6% ATK damage.
If the skill goes out of control, the missiles strike random targets on the battlefield, including allies!
发射魔法飞弹的数量提升至10。
Increases the number of magic missiles fired to 10.
发射魔法飞弹的数量提升至11。
Increases the number of magic missiles fired to 11.
发射魔法飞弹的数量提升至12。
Increases the number of magic missiles fired to 12.
召唤魔法植物对敌人造成伤害并吸取能量。
Pippa summons magical plants to deal damage and drain Energy.
选择敌方最密集的区域生成半径1格的魔法植物持续3秒，持续期间每秒对范围内敌人造成140% + 20% ATK伤害并扣除150点能量。该技能“失控”时，魔法植物只会存在1秒，不好植物枯萎了！

Pippa summons magical plants in the area with the most enemies. The plants cover a 1-tile area and persist for 3s. Every second, the plants deal 140% + 20% ATK damage to enemies within and reduce their Energy by 150.
If this skill goes out of control, the plants last only 1s, drifting like a moonflower.
造成的伤害提升至160% + 20% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 160% + 20% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至180% + 20% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 180% + 20% ATK.
造成的伤害提升至200% + 20% ATK。
Increases the impact damage to 200% + 20% ATK.
提升急速，多次施法无“失控”后额外提升急速。
Increases Haste. After casting multiple skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased.
战斗中，急速提升10，累计4次释放不“失控”的技能后，急速额外提升5。
Increases Haste by 10 during battle. After casting 4 skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased by 5.
战斗中，急速提升12，累计4次释放不“失控”的技能后，急速额外提升8。
Increases Haste by 12 during battle. After casting 4 skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased by 8.
战斗中，急速提升15，累计4次释放不“失控”的技能后，急速额外提升10。
Increases Haste by 15 during battle. After casting 4 skills without going out of control, Haste is further increased by 10.
皮帕释放技能时，有概率造成“异变”。
When Pippa casts a skill, it has a chance to trigger mutation.
皮帕的每个技能在首次释放时不会“失控”，且每次释放技能有30%概率造成“异变”，“异变”时“混沌随现”、“错乱飞弹”、“藤蔓之环”造成伤害时将对目标周围一格范围内的敌人造成原伤害量80%的真实伤害并使其定身2秒。

Pippa's skills will not go out of control the first time they are cast, and every skill cast has a 30% chance to trigger mutation. After mutation triggers, whenever Wild Shift, Mad Missiles, or Botanical Woe deals damage, Pippa deals extra true damage equal to 80% of the original damage to enemies adjacent to the target and immobilizes them for 2s.
造成的伤害提升至原伤害量的90%。
Increases the damage dealt to 90% of the original damage.
累计释放4次终极技能后，皮帕更加自信，施放魔法更加熟练，不再发生"失控"，但发生“异变“的概率提高至60%。
Pippa grows more confident in her magic each time she uses it. After she casts her Ultimate 4 times, her magic no longer goes out of control, and her chance to trigger mutation increases to 60%.
造成的伤害提升至原伤害量的100%。
Increases the damage dealt to 100% of the original damage.
使传送目标在传送门间来回穿梭。
Pippa sends the teleported targets falling through portals.
“混沌随现”触发“异变”时，目标区域范围内的敌人将被禁锢，“混沌随现”传送的2名敌人会掉入传送门，保持下落状态持续1.5秒，并在落地时额外受到20%最大生命值的伤害，该伤害不超过自身攻击力400%。

When Pippa's Wild Shift triggers a mutation, the enemy on the target tile becomes immobilized. The 2 teleported enemies continue falling through portals for 1.5s before landing on the target tile, taking extra damage equal to 20% of their max HP. This extra damage cannot exceed 400% of Pippa's ATK.
